#!/bin/sh
# Pulls the source-of-truth inventory app.conf from node1 and applies it locally if changed.
set -eu

SRC_HOST="10.100.203.10"
SRC_USER="antrieb"
DEST_DIR="/etc/inventory"
DEST_FILE="$DEST_DIR/app.conf"
TMP_FILE="/tmp/app.conf.sync.$$"

cleanup() { rm -f "$TMP_FILE"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "${SRC_USER}@${SRC_HOST}" 'sudo -n cat /etc/inventory/app.conf' > "$TMP_FILE"

if [ ! -s "$TMP_FILE" ]; then
    echo "$(date -Is) sync failed: empty fetch from ${SRC_HOST}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

sudo mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"

if [ -f "$DEST_FILE" ] && cmp -s "$TMP_FILE" "$DEST_FILE"; then
    echo "$(date -Is) no change"
    exit 0
fi

sudo cp "$TMP_FILE" "$DEST_FILE"
sudo chmod 644 "$DEST_FILE"
echo "$(date -Is) synced update from ${SRC_HOST}"
EOF
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-conf.sh
sudo mkdir -p /var/log
sudo touch /var/log/inventory-sync.log
sudo chown antrieb:antrieb /var/log/inventory-sync.log
cat /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-conf.sh
